name: FOSS card game server and frontend

mentions.name: FOSS card game server and frontend
mentions.description: This FOSS card game consists of a simple server that reads card data from a database and processes gameplay with lightweight server-side code, plus a basic frontend, to be released under the MIT license. It is designed so a community can build multiple interchangeable frontends (e.g. a CLI client or an Unreal client) that are compatible with the same server.
mentions.problem: After trying backend tools like Supabase and Firebase, the author found they need to write their own solution because they don't need a bunch of enterprise-level features, just card data storage and simple server-side game processing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a FOSS card game.

I realized after trying multiple tools like Supabase and Firebase, I really need to program my own solution. I don't need a bunch of *Enterprise* level features. I just need to read the card data from a database, and process the games with some simple server side code.

I hope to have the server, along with a basic front end done by this summer. Then it'll be released under a permissible license. Probably MIT.
